summary: Play Reversi, Draughts, Nine Men's Morris and Kalah on one Kobo.
page_description: Four classic board games for two players passing one Kobo, or against the computer at three levels. Every move is saved.
release_notes: Read every move through measured record pages and return to the unchanged board with Back. Page taps and reader buttons keep long games readable; board actions remain visible after save failures at large text sizes.
